# Shyam Software

> Custom software development company in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, building ERP, e-commerce, and jewelry-industry software since 2012.

## What this is
Shyam Software builds business software for Indian retailers, wholesalers, and jewelers. Active SaaS products: BusinessERP (billing/inventory/GST) and Ecom (B2B customer ledger/ordering portal). Also builds JewelSoft ERP and custom software for jewelry, retail, and manufacturing businesses.

## Key facts
- Company: Shyam Software
- Founded: 2012
- Location: Rajkot, Gujarat, India
- Products: BusinessERP, Ecom, JewelSoft ERP, ProductScan
- Support languages: Hindi, Gujarati, English
